 SportsLine's model has locked in its best bets for Saturday's Big Ten matchup featuring the Northwestern Wildcats vs. Ohio State Buckeyes
 By

 Nov 14, 2026
 at

 •

 Imagn Images 
 A Big Ten showdown is set as Northwestern arrived on Friday before the ground stoppage in Columbus to face No. 20 Ohio State on Saturday. The Wildcats (6-3) have covered the spread in five of eight games this season, while the Buckeyes (6-3), hosting at the Horseshoe, are looking to get right in front of their home crowd after dropping two straight. Luke Fahey will get another start at quarterback for the Buckeyes with Julian Sayin still out indefinitely. Nicco Marchiol is expected to start in place of Aidan Chiles for Northwestern.
